safety_boundary.one_prototype: all H8 work targets the one assembled prototype; no sacrificial assembled unit is required
safety_boundary.non_destructive: ordinary measurements, controlled operation, inspection and 24/48-hour soak; no drop, vibration or arbitrary cycle-count campaign
safety_boundary.fault_injection: battery, NTC and destructive-state equivalents use current-limited simulators or emulators; real cells stay inside exact MPN limits and MAX17320 update endurance is not deliberately exhausted
safety_boundary.forbidden: irreversible fuse/key burns, intentional real-cell abuse and claims of physical completion before the evidence exists
